title: המשדר שחלש כמו נורת מקרר — ושומעים אותו מ־26 מיליארד ק״מ
summary: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day (25.9 billion km, 173 AU) on 18 Nov 2026: light-travel time (Moon 1.3 s, Sun 8.3 min, Voyager ~24 h, a question-and-answer takes two days), the inverse-square law with a torch on a grid, why 70 m DSN dishes catch a ~20 W whisper (area ∝ diameter², 160 bps vs 115,200 at Jupiter), the 2023–24 remote memory fix and the fading plutonium RTG, the Golden Record's Hebrew 'shalom', and a light-day calculation (300,000 × 86,400) with a 17 km/s challenge (~48 years per light-day).
reviewer_verdict: PASS (2 rounds) — nits left: prose ~1,350/1,500 words per track, above the 1,100 target (≈25–32 min); in the torch lab the lit squares sit off-centre at even distances; the '80 מטר' label touches the field border on phones; kit lint/check missing from the repo so local stand-ins were used; Arto and the AI grader not exercised on file://; the review copy doesn't declare the sample capability, so Arto falls back there (template)
